title: Debt and Protocol
author: Isandro Galloway
blurb: Ines Delacroix, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
